name: Size Translator
need: Figure out your size in a brand you've never bought from.
description: Enter a garment that already fits you — brand, size, and fit — and it tells you the closest size in another brand, with a confidence note. Works from manufacturer-published size charts bundled with the app; nothing you type leaves your browser.
limitations: Covers 40 brands, mostly US and EU womenswear.
Size charts are manufacturer-published and often optimistic.
Vanity sizing drift means a 2019 garment may not match the current chart.
No menswear, no children's sizing, no shoes.
